about: The four Larpo founder accounts. `scheduled: false` = the planner never schedules a post there. `manual: true` = the owner posts by hand: assets reserved for him are listed in the day plan as 'yours to post', with caption options, never scheduled. `freshOnly: true` = only designs that were never posted anywhere and are not reserved for someone else. `lane` = the subject world this account's new designs come from, so the four feeds never look alike (proposal, change freely). profileId is the X engine profile id (not the handle); placeholders until each founder confirms theirs (knowledge/x/x-engine-audit.md section 5).
